name: Matter Logic
description:
Two logic structures that let your factory react to the matter that is actually sitting in it.

[h3]Matter Scanner[/h3]
Counts every element type inside its 4x4 zone, instead of only reporting "full" or "not empty" like the vanilla sensors. Click it to see its live readings, element by element.

[h3]Condition Combinator[/h3]
Wire scanners into it with the Signal Linker, then set up to 8 conditions of the form [b]element / operator / value[/b], using =, !=, >, >=, < or <=, joined by ALL or ANY.

Its output is an ordinary on/off signal, so every vanilla receiver accepts it: airlocks, lamps, AND / OR / NOT gates, and the rest.

[h3]Example[/h3]
Keep an airlock shut until a batch is ready: two scanners wired into one combinator, mode ALL, with [b]Redsand >= 4[/b] and [b]Amethelis >= 4[/b].

[h3]Details[/h3]
[list]
[*]Several scanners wired into the same combinator add their counts together, the way several wires feeding one network do.
[*]The element picker mirrors the Advanced Filter: real element colours, the same Solid / Liquid / Gas tabs, a search box, and only the elements you have discovered.
[*]Conditions stay editable after placement and are saved with your game.
[*]Both structures unlock with the Logic Gates research, next to the vanilla gates.
[*]Available in English and French.
[/list]

[h3]Source[/h3]
https://github.com/kardagan/sandustry-matter-logic
